The human explicitly authorized **one** small native Sol 6.1 Ultra turn in a disposable project, read-only Arcane MCP, and no Studio edits/uploads/installs. That approval was consumed once; it does not authorize additional inference tests.

- Native installed-CLI subscription connection and exact catalogue pair `gpt-6.1-sol` / `ultra` were verified. No model or API-billing fallback.

Immutable observation report (`runtime/verification/native-one-turn-mkdhgr/verification.json`, local evidence, not committed). ## Scope and remaining work

This establishes a real completed native response, read-only Arcane MCP execution and public history hydration for this exact tested thread. It is not end-to-end interactive desktop rendering, applied-effort telemetry, general entitlement, future account availability, native asset/write authorization, Claude embedded subscription support, or Studio/plugin acceptance. A disposable Studio fixture is now accessible; fresh pairing and native edit/restore acceptance remain separate. Hunted was not inspected or modified.

The tested old bundle's MCP skill loader resolved registry code from the selected project, a portability/security problem for arbitrary user workspaces. The source is now fixed and tested against bundle-owned code; this unchanged-bundle run deliberately tested `work_runs`, not skill lookup. See [BUNDLED_SKILLS.md](BUNDLED_SKILLS.md). A new accepted executable must include that fix before it is recommended for arbitrary workspaces.
